name: shadowiron
lore_descriptor: black as pitch, edges absorbing torchlight
first_pickup_chronicle: Shadowiron. Drains me a little every turn. Worth it for what it does to the dead. I am told the smiths who worked this metal did not live past forty. I am told they did good work.
design_notes: Peak F82 spread 12. damage_mult 1.55 — TOP raw damage in the bank. The catch: drains 1 HP per turn equipped. cite: curve F82 monster_damage_med ≈ 13; a 1-HP drain per turn is meaningful (~7.5% of player_hp_target P at F82 over a 30-turn fight). cannot_be_blessed — necrotic alignment. effective_against celestial AS WELL AS undead/fiend — shadowiron damages EVERYONE, including the player's angel allies. Tactical risk material. void_aligned flag enables Abaddon-side karma interactions. No armor — wearing shadowiron plate would kill the player in 100 turns.
